name: Hypersonica

sources.quote: Hypersonica was initially incubated by TUM Venture Labs. The company is headquartered in the Munich area with a wholly owned subsidiary in London.
Founded in December 2023 by University of Oxford PhDs and German nationals Dr. Marc Ewenz and Dr. Philipp Kerth

Hypersonica, the British-German defence company developing sovereign hypersonic deep-strike systems for Europe and its allies
today announced a €100 million Series B financing round co-led by Lightspeed and General Catalyst
today announced a €100 million Series B financing round co-led by Lightspeed and General Catalyst

In February, the company successfully tested its prototype HS-1, achieving speeds above Mach 6 over a range exceeding 300 kilometres and becoming the first privately funded European defence company to hit this milestone.

funFact: In February 2026 Hypersonica flew its HS-1 prototype at over Mach 6 for more than 300 km, a first for a privately funded European defence company.
